versions.name: Docker registry login
versions.description: Log the Docker CLI into a registry for later steps (docker build/push, engine docker pulls). Credentials land in the job-scoped DOCKER_CONFIG dir and are removed when the job ends. Requires the Docker CLI on the Runner host.
versions.description_zh: 登录容器镜像仓库，供后续步骤使用（docker build/push、docker 引擎拉私有镜像）。凭证写入 job 级 DOCKER_CONFIG 目录，job 结束即清除。需要 Runner 主机装有 Docker CLI。
versions.author: buz maintainers

versions.name: Docker registry login
versions.description: Log the Docker CLI into a registry for later steps (docker build/push, engine docker pulls). Credentials land in the job-scoped DOCKER_CONFIG dir and are removed when the job ends. Optional debug output shows a redacted command and exit status. Requires the Docker CLI on the Runner host.
versions.description_zh: 登录容器镜像仓库，供后续步骤使用（docker build/push、docker 引擎拉私有镜像）。凭证写入 job 级 DOCKER_CONFIG 目录，job 结束即清除。可选 debug 输出脱敏命令和退出码。需要 Runner 主机装有 Docker CLI。
versions.author: buz maintainers
